scientific_question: If every routed expert node receives its own learned full-rank 768x768 input frame, while the fixed node-specific signed-FHT S/T maps and rank-448 write basis are unchanged, can the parent shared-frame family recover both heldout expert outputs and analytic input JVPs?

causal_parent.finding: At the learned shared-frame endpoints, within-layer expert frame gradients have mean pairwise cosine -0.03435 to -0.05456 and cancellation 0.07724 to 0.09711, while fixed-endpoint cross-bank gradient cosine is 0.7020 to 0.7067. Yet the largest budget-compatible 64-group modulation captures only 0.0137 to 0.0285 percent of diagonal-cell gradient energy. Expert-specific orientation is real, but grouped scaling is not its geometry.

theory.discriminator: The parent complete expert is f_n(x)=V[d_n elementwise T_n(GELU(S_n(Wx)+b_n))]. Replacing W by W_n changes only sharing. If independently fitted W_n passes, the one shared frame is the binding restriction. If W_n fails, the remaining fixed S_n/T_n/GELU topology cannot express the dense expert even without frame sharing.
theory.candidate_formula: For node n, p_n=S_n(W_n x)+b_n; h_n=GELU(p_n); q_n=d_n elementwise T_n(h_n); f_n(x)=V q_n. Each W_n is independently row-normalized and initialized from the corresponding bank's saved fitted shared frame.
theory.continued_control: For every node, continue fitting the already node-private b_n and d_n from the identical saved parent endpoint for the same steps and data while freezing W at the saved shared frame. This controls for additional optimization and node-separable fitting time.
theory.why_non_deployable: The full 96-node family contains 96*768^2 private frame coordinates. It is a causal structural ceiling only, not a compression candidate, Mapping Networks implementation, LoRA, or training proposal.
theory.scope: Zero checkpoint updates. Bank-specific rank-448 write bases and teacher-supervised dense targets remain terminal-derived and noncausal. A pass authorizes only decomposition theory for the fitted private-frame field.

candidate.name: node_private_fullrank_input_frame_ceiling
candidate.initialization: Clone the saved bank-specific learned shared raw_frame into every selected node; clone the same node's saved hidden_bias and output_modulation.

continued_control.name: continued_saved_shared_frame_control
continued_control.initialization: Identical saved parent endpoint and node bias/modulation.

data_protocol.sampling: Exact terminal top-2 routing. Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout activations do not affect optimization, topology, step, LR, thresholds, or selection.

fit_protocol.objective: Equal-layer/equal-expert normalized rank-448 coefficient output MSE plus 1.0 times normalized analytic coefficient-JVP MSE.
fit_protocol.selection: Final registered step only. No heldout model selection or hyperparameter change.

decision_rule.pass: Both independently fitted banks pass every absolute, gain, action, occupancy, and finite gate. Conclude shared orientation is binding. Save private frames and authorize only a preregistered zero-update cross-bank decomposition/predictability audit seeking a genuinely nonlinear node-conditioned decoder above 200x; do not implement or train the private family.
decision_rule.output_pass_jvp_fail: Endpoint geometry can be repaired by node-private frames but the fixed S/T normal topology still fails local derivatives. Close the topology for full replacement; no FHT stage, seed, LR, or width sweep.
decision_rule.fail: Either bank misses any output absolute/gain gate. Close the fixed signed-FHT S/T plus GELU topology even with node-private dense frames. No retry, optimizer, step, rank, seed, activation, or threshold sweep.

systems.performance_rule: Run focused tests and an exact-shape candidate/control timing and memory gate. Foreground-poll only if projected complete runtime is at most five minutes; otherwise attach and verify a terminal/error @Codex watchdog before launch.
